messages: Hi! I'm planning a trip to Lisbon in May.
Any tips for the first day?
Is the weather warm that time of year?
How do I get from the airport to the city?
Which neighborhood is best to stay in?
What local food should I try?
Is it safe to walk around at night?
Can you suggest a day trip?
replyRemembered: Bien sûr ! Je vous conseille de commencer par le quartier d'Alfama.
replyForgotten: Sure! I recommend starting with the Alfama neighborhood.
